image_description: Three baseballs are displayed inside a clear plastic or acrylic rack with metal framing. The balls appear to be official Major League Baseballs, featuring the standard white leather cover and red stitching. The leftmost ball shows blue ink stamps/logos, while the middle and right balls show the traditional red stitching pattern clearly. The background is dark and industrial, possibly a dugout or storage area.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The objects are clearly spherical and proportionate to the rack structure, consistent with hand-sized sports balls.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Perfectly round with uniform surface texture.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The silhouettes are circular without visible deformations. The white leather texture appears consistent across the visible surfaces.
The cover is white with a slight sheen characteristic of leather or high-quality synthetic materials used in baseballs.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Cover consists of two figure-eight-shaped pieces stitched together.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The seam pattern on the middle and right balls follows the characteristic figure-eight geometry of a standard baseball construction.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Raised red thread forming distinctive curved seam pattern with numerous double stitches.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Red stitching is clearly visible on all three balls. The middle ball shows the double-stitch detail and raised nature of the thread effectively.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Red stitching provides high contrast against white background.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The red color stands out sharply against the white leather, meeting the high-contrast requirement.
Specular highlights on the upper curves of the balls indicate a smooth, slightly glossy surface typical of new or well-maintained baseballs.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Firm but slightly compressible feel from cork and rubber core wrapped in yarn.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: This is a tactile property that cannot be visually verified from a static image.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White cover with red stitching is traditional appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visual appearance matches the canonical look of a professional baseball.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The blue stamping on the left ball contains illegible characters and distorted logo shapes, common in AI generation where text rendering fails. It resembles 'OFFICIAL LEAGUE' text but is garbled.
While the stitching is present, some individual stitch holes lack perfect definition and merge slightly into the leather texture upon close inspection, lacking the crispness of a macro photograph.

The vertical and horizontal supports of the rack exhibit slight warping and inconsistent thickness. The connection points between the metal frame and plastic dividers are somewhat ambiguous and physically imprecise.
